domains.title: Domains, websites or emails
domains.description: Company domains ("stripe.com"), website URLs ("https://www.hubspot.com/pricing") or work emails ("jane@acme.com"). Emails are reduced to their domain; the part before @ is never stored or output. Duplicates are removed.

maxDomains.title: Max domains
maxDomains.description: Check at most this many unique domains per run (default 1000), to keep costs predictable. Aliases: maxItems, limit, maxResults.

datasetId.title: Or: dataset ID from another Actor
datasetId.description: Optional. Check the domains in another run's dataset, e.g. Google Maps, lead or company scraper results. Example: "aBcD1234efGH5678". In an integration (run this after another Actor finishes) use {{resource.defaultDatasetId}}.

domainField.title: Domain field in that dataset
domainField.description: Field holding the domain, website or email, e.g. "website" (dot paths like "company.domain" work). Leave empty to auto-detect: domain, companyDomain, website, websiteUrl, companyWebsite, companyUrl, homepage, email, emails, companyEmail, workEmail, url, loc.

datasetMaxItems.title: Max values from the dataset
datasetMaxItems.description: Read at most this many values from the dataset (default 1000).

checkDkim.title: Probe common DKIM selectors
checkDkim.description: Look up google, selector1, selector2, k1, s1 and default DKIM selectors. Helps find the real mailbox behind a gateway. Adds 12 DNS queries per domain.

countSpfLookups.title: Count SPF DNS lookups
countSpfLookups.description: Follow SPF includes recursively and flag records over the 10-lookup limit (SPF permerror).

detectSaas.title: Detect SaaS from TXT verification records
detectSaas.description: List tools the company verified its domain with (Microsoft 365, Atlassian, OpenAI, Slack, Zoom, DocuSign and 40 more).

includeRawRecords.title: Include raw DNS records
includeRawRecords.description: Add the raw MX, SPF, DMARC and TXT records to each row (larger output).

dnsTimeoutSecs.title: DNS timeout (seconds)
dnsTimeoutSecs.description: Per-query timeout before falling back to DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare, then Google).
